import zlib


def h(s):
    return zlib.crc32(s.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFFF


DEPS_FIRST = [
    ("FROM node:22-bookworm", []),
    ("WORKDIR /app", []),
    ("COPY package.json package-lock.json ./", ["package.json", "package-lock.json"]),
    ("RUN npm ci", []),
    ("COPY . .", ["*"]),
    ("RUN npm run build", []),
]

ANTI_PATTERN = [
    ("FROM node:22-bookworm", []),
    ("WORKDIR /app", []),
    ("COPY . .", ["*"]),
    ("RUN npm ci", []),
    ("RUN npm run build", []),
]

BASE = {
    "package.json": "p1",
    "package-lock.json": "l1",
    "src/app.js": "a1",
    "src/style.css": "c1",
}


def layer_hashes(dockerfile, files):
    prev = "root"
    out = []
    for instr, deps in dockerfile:
        if "*" in deps:
            sig = "|".join("%s=%s" % (k, files[k]) for k in sorted(files))
        else:
            sig = "|".join("%s=%s" % (d, files.get(d, "")) for d in deps)
        prev = "%08x" % h("%s\0%s\0%s" % (prev, instr, sig))
        out.append((instr, prev))
    return out


def simulate(dockerfile, changed):
    files = dict(BASE)
    files.update(changed)
    before = layer_hashes(dockerfile, BASE)
    after = layer_hashes(dockerfile, files)
    cached = 0
    for (_, a), (_, b) in zip(before, after):
        if a == b:
            cached += 1
        else:
            break
    return cached, len(dockerfile) - cached, before, after


print("base_files=%s" % "|".join("%s=%s" % (k, BASE[k]) for k in sorted(BASE)))
for label, df in (("deps_first", DEPS_FIRST), ("copy_all_first", ANTI_PATTERN)):
    print("=== %s (layers=%d) ===" % (label, len(df)))
    for change in ({"src/app.js": "a2"}, {"package.json": "p2"}, {"src/style.css": "c2"}):
        cached, rebuilt, before, after = simulate(df, change)
        key = list(change)[0]
        npm_ci_rebuild = dict(after)["RUN npm ci"] != dict(before)["RUN npm ci"]
        print("  change=%-20s cached=%d rebuilt=%d npm_ci_layer_rebuild=%s"
              % (key, cached, rebuilt, npm_ci_rebuild))

c1 = simulate(DEPS_FIRST, {"src/app.js": "a2"})
c2 = simulate(ANTI_PATTERN, {"src/app.js": "a2"})
print("=== judgement ===")
print("source_edit_rebuilds_deps_first=%d" % c1[1])
print("source_edit_rebuilds_copy_all_first=%d" % c2[1])
print("deps_first_saves_layers=%d" % (c2[1] - c1[1]))
print("cache_is_prefix_chain=%s" % (c1[0] + c1[1] == len(DEPS_FIRST)))
